cards.text: Jesus is on the move. He goes through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the gospel of the kingdom. Town after town after TOWN, friend, and I get winded just hopping my gold base from one oven to the next.

cards.question: As Jesus goes through all those towns and villages, He heals every disease and sickness.

cards.text: Then Jesus looks out at the crowds. Matthew says He's moved with compassion for them.

cards.question: Why is Jesus moved with compassion for the crowds?

answers.text: They are tired from following Him
They have walked far from home

cards.question: The crowds are harassed and helpless. What picture does Matthew use to describe them?

cards.text: Sheep without a shepherd is a forty-person group chat where NOBODY is making the plan. Then Jesus turns to His disciples and starts talking about a harvest.

cards.question: Jesus tells His disciples the harvest is plentiful, and the workers are plentiful too.
The harvest is plentiful and the workers are few, so Jesus tells His disciples to ___ the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest.

cards.text: Then Jesus calls His twelve disciples to Him. When I got called, friend, I was under a stack of takeout menus with dust all over my mustache.

cards.question: Jesus calls His twelve disciples to Him. What does He give them?
With the authority Jesus gives them, the twelve can drive out unclean spirits and heal ___ disease and sickness.

cards.text: Then Matthew lists the names of the twelve apostles. It opens with two pairs of brothers: Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew, then James son of Zebedee and his brother John. Matthew the tax collector makes the list, and it ends with Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus. Twelve names on the roster, friend, and their story is only getting started.

findings.problem: This non-opening story card has four sentences. Condense the apostle-list summary and the closing story-continuation line to one or two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
